ideas.pitch: An automated trading system deployed on Azure that continuously scans perpetual DEXs and centralized exchanges to execute delta-neutral funding rate arbitrage strategies.
ideas.title: AzurePerp: Autonomous Multi-Exchange Funding Rate Arbitrage Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core finance and trading thesis of Hefty-Hacks while leveraging Azure for reliable, low-latency cloud execution infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace that executes over-the-counter options contracts using USDC escrow payments, preventing counterparty risk without manual mediation.
ideas.title: EventopiaFi: USDC Escrow Agent for Automated OTC Options Trading
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates sponsor tooling from Eventopia while solving a critical execution and trust problem in decentralized financial derivatives.

ideas.pitch: A self-custodial credit and risk engine that assesses under-collateralized lending limits using zero-knowledge identity proofs without revealing private portfolio balances.
ideas.title: ZeroKnowRisk: ZK-Identity Based Leveraged Credit Line
ideas.why_it_could_win: Blends institutional risk management requirements with cutting-edge cryptographic compliance, appealing heavily to quants and judges looking for deep domain expertise.

ideas.pitch: A no-code platform allowing retail traders to prompt, backtest, and deploy complex quant strategies and cross-chain execution scripts directly onto perpetual markets.
ideas.title: PerpNoCode: Natural Language Strategy Builder for Perpetuals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of previous grand-prize-winning trading bots by lowering the barrier to entry for sophisticated financial tooling.

ideas.pitch: A micro-transaction cross-chain bridge optimized specifically for aggregating and arbitraging fractional residual token balances starting from $0.10.
ideas.title: MicroBridge Arbitrage: Cross-Chain Dust Liquidation Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-frequency, low-value edge cases in decentralized liquidity that traditional bridges ignore, demonstrating exceptional engineering depth.
